lines.meet: Raúl Castillo, bull rider out of Tucson. Fifteen years on the circuit, and I've still got all my teeth, mostly.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're in the Settlement too! I'm the loud one in the market with the big shiny buckle. You can't miss me.
lines.ask_home: So where'd you ride in from? You've got a look about you.
lines.ask_work: What'd you do back home, {compadre|comadre}? Something that hurt, I hope.
lines.answer_home: Tucson, Arizona, in the desert. Saguaros, monsoon storms in the summer, and the best carne asada on the planet.
lines.answer_work: Bull riding, the rodeo circuit, fifteen years. Eight seconds on fifteen hundred pounds of bad attitude, every weekend.
lines.chat_food: My mom's tamales at Christmas, red chile pork, a whole pot of them. I'd fight a bull with my bare hands for one.
lines.chat_sleep: Truck, ground, a hay bale behind the chutes, it doesn't matter. I can sleep anywhere, it comes with the job.
lines.chat_missing: The roar when the gate opens and the whole arena's screaming. Nothing up here sounds like that.
lines.chat_here: I rode a raptor on a dare my first month and stayed on nine seconds. The headhunters still talk about it.
lines.tease_quiet: You don't say much, {name}. All business until the gate opens, just how I like it.
lines.tease_talker: You talk more than a rodeo announcer, {name}, and that's saying something.
lines.tease_careful: You'd check the cinch five times before you got on, {name}. Smart, sure, but the crowd's leaving.
lines.tease_bold: You'd climb on anything, {name}. I love it, and I'm worried about you in equal measure.
lines.tease_any: You'd last about two seconds on a bull, {name}. Three if I'm generous.
lines.tease_back: Ha, you got me there, {name}, fair and square!
lines.take_it_kindly: You're not wrong, {name}. My mom would say the exact same thing.
lines.bristle: Don't go there, {name}. A friend took a horn for me once, and I don't laugh about it.
lines.needle_quiet: Say something when you see trouble coming, would you? Silence gets people stomped.
lines.needle_talker: A little quiet, {compadre|comadre}. You're spooking everything for a mile.
lines.needle_careful: If you think that long in the chute, the bull's gonna make the decision for you.
lines.needle_bold: Even I think you're reckless, and I ride bulls for fun. Ease up a little.
lines.needle_any: You flinch at everything, and out here a flinch gets you thrown.
lines.bite_back: I've been at the front of every fight we've had, swinging. Don't tell me I don't pull my weight.
lines.hurt: Okay, that one landed, I'll admit it. I'm gonna go polish my buckle and sulk.
lines.laugh_off: A drunk at Cheyenne Frontier Days once said worse about my mother, and I let it go. You'll need better than that.
lines.apologise: My bad, that came out mean. I get loud when I'm tired.
lines.double_down: Nope, I meant it, and I'll say it twice if you want. Somebody had to be honest.
lines.confide: {name}, my best friend stepped in front of a bull for me in 2019. He walked again, but he never fought another one.
lines.listen: Talk to me, {name}. I'm a good listener when I shut up, I swear.
lines.look_out: Get behind me, {name}, I've got this one.
lines.accept: Your call, {name}. You call the ride.
lines.deflect: Barely a scratch, {name}, a fence post did worse. Help somebody else.
lines.check_in: You okay, {name}? Show me, you went down hard.
lines.blame: Somebody let go too early, and the whole thing went sideways.
lines.thank: You saved my hide there, {compadre|comadre}. Drinks are on me tonight, all of them.
lines.brush_off: Forget it, jumping in is what I do best.
lines.worry: Hey, {name}, eyes on me. You're gonna be fine, hang on.
lines.handed_down: This belongs to you, {compadre|comadre}. Take it back.
lines.hand_fine: Go on, have it. I rode in jeans and a vest for fifteen years.
lines.hand_sulk: Didn't ask the bull rider, huh. That's cold, but fine.
lines.turn_friendly: You're all right, {name}. I'd let you hold my hat at the chute, and I don't let just anybody.
lines.turn_friends: You're my bullfighter now, {name}. I'd trust you in the ring with me any day.
lines.turn_grating: We just don't click, us two. That's okay, we can still get the job done.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still jump in if something's goring you. Don't expect me to buy the drinks after.
lines.make_up: Come on, {name}, let's quit this. Shake on it?
lines.defend: Hey, back off, that's not right. {name} held their own the whole way.
lines.friend_left: Feels wrong without {name} around, like a rodeo with no announcer.
lines.friend_back: {name}, welcome back! Now we've got a real crew again.
lines.common_animals: You're good with animals, I can tell. A horse would let you on first try.
lines.common_sport: You played something, didn't you? You stand like somebody who's taken a hit and got up.
lines.common_mexico: You're Mexican too! Where's your family from? Mine are from Sonora, way back.
lines.common_spanish: Órale, somebody who speaks Spanish! Finally I can swear at someone properly.
lines.common_american: You sound like the States! Where'd you grow up? I haven't heard home in somebody's voice in forever.
